title: South Korea tenders 6.6 GWh of six-hour storage under 15-year contracts
content:
The Korea Power Exchange has launched its 2026 ESS tender for 1.18 GW of six-hour storage, targeting 1.1 GW on mainland Korea and 80 MW on Jeju, with projects due by February 2029. Bids will be assessed 50% on price and 50% on non-price factors, including fire safety, grid-forming capability, supply-chain resilience, Korean economic contribution, maintenance, recycling, and project experience.

title: Canadian province announces PV panel recycling fee
content:

title: The $21 billion capex bill: analyzing the cost of the U.S. 100 GW module production milestone
content: New analysis by Terawatt PV Research reveals that about $21 billion of cumulative manufacturing capital expenditure was spent in the United States by the time domestic module production output passed 100 GW in Q2 2026.
